_what_this_is: the discover step's proposals (model call); the confirm step looks each up in the registries

proposals.title: Effectiveness of interventions for improving educational outcomes for people with disabilities in low‐ and middle‐income countries: A systematic review
proposals.why: Most recent Campbell systematic review directly answering which education interventions work for disabled people in LMICs.

proposals.title: Implementation of Inclusive Education: A Systematic Review of Studies of Inclusive Education Interventions in Low- and Lower-Middle-Income Countries
proposals.container: International Journal of Disability, Development and Education
proposals.why: First systematic review of inclusive education interventions specifically in low- and lower-middle-income countries; 31 studies across 19 countries.

proposals.title: Evidence and gap map of studies assessing the effectiveness of interventions for people with disabilities in low‐and middle‐income countries
proposals.why: Comprehensive evidence and gap map covering education and other outcomes for disability interventions in LMICs; identifies evidence gaps.

proposals.title: Teacher professional development for disability inclusion in low‐ and middle‐income Asia‐Pacific countries: An evidence and gap map
proposals.why: Evidence and gap map on teacher training interventions for disability-inclusive education in LMIC Asia-Pacific; 50 studies across 16 countries.

proposals.title: Global Education Monitoring Report 2020: Inclusion and education: All means all
proposals.why: Major global assessment of inclusive education policies and implementation worldwide, including disability and LMIC contexts.

proposals.title: Rapid Evidence Assessment (REA) of What Works to Improve Educational Outcomes for People with Disabilities in Low- and Middle-Income Countries
proposals.container: International Centre for Evidence in Disability / Campbell Collaboration
proposals.why: DFID-commissioned rapid evidence assessment of effective educational interventions for disabled people in LMICs; foundational reference for the field.

proposals.title: Effectiveness of interventions for children and adolescents with autism spectrum disorder in high-income vs. lower middle-income countries: An overview of systematic reviews and research papers from LMIC
proposals.why: Meta-review comparing ASD intervention effectiveness between HICs and LMICs; finds very limited LMIC evidence and no evidence-based interventions.

proposals.title: Inclusive education: children with disabilities (Background paper for the 2020 Global Education Monitoring Report)
proposals.container: UNESCO / Global Education Monitoring Report Team
proposals.why: Background paper synthesising evidence on inclusive education for children with disabilities prepared for the 2020 GEM Report.
